events.title: R&B Night
events.description: Join us for R&B Night with DJ Torrey Tee every Wednesday at Christopher Cellars. We’re open from 4:00 PM to 8:00 PM , with wines by the glass, bottle, flights, wine slushies and more available all night long. Taeza’s Bottom Line BBQ will be out serving up their slow-smoked BBQ favorites, with smoked meats, hearty sides and plenty of good food to go with a night of wine and R&B. No cover charge. Open seating. Come early, grab a table, order some BBQ and wine, and settle in for the night. Torrey Tee is a Sacramento-based DJ, creative and cultural curator with a talent for turning music into experiences. Known for his ability to read a room and move seamlessly through R&B, Hip-Hop, Bay Area classics, throwbacks and open-format selections, Torrey brings an intentional approach to every set. His style is rooted in creating the right atmosphere, knowing when to set the tone, when to bring the energy and how to make a room feel connected through music. His versatility has taken him across nightlife, weddings, festivals, community events, corporate experiences and some of Sacramento’s most recognizable venues and organizations. Along the way, he’s worked with Macy’s, the City of Sacramento, St. HOPE, Coin-Op, the R&B Running Series and other brands and organizations throughout Northern California. Beyond the booth, Torrey is a photographer, filmmaker, creative entrepreneur and founder of Full Effect Films and Full Effect Entertainment. His work lives at the intersection of music, visuals, culture and community, giving him a unique perspective on creating experiences that are bigger than the music alone. Now bringing that approach to Christopher Cellars as our resident Wednesday night DJ , Torrey is helping create a night centered around great wine, good food, good people and the sounds of R&B. From the records you grew up on to the ones defining the genre today. For Torrey Tee, it’s never just about what’s playing. It’s about how the room feels when it plays.

events.title: Murder Mystery at The Cellar: A Haunting 40 Years in the Making
events.description: This murder mystery is going to be one for the books! Forty years ago, a mysterious murder took place in the cellar. The crime was never solved, and the victim's spirit has been haunting the grounds ever since. Now, four decades later, the ghost is ready to reveal the truth. But will you be able to uncover the killer before the night is over? Join us at Christopher Cellars for an immersive evening of mystery, suspense, and a little supernatural activity. Arrive dressed in your Halloween best, enjoy a complimentary glass of wine included with your ticket, and prepare to follow the clues, question the suspects, and uncover secrets buried for 40 years. Throughout the evening, enjoy light bites, specialty drinks available for purchase, and take part in a séance where the spirits may hold the final clue to solving the mystery. Your ticket includes: An interactive murder mystery experience One complimentary glass of Christopher Cellars wine Light bites throughout the evening A séance to help uncover the killer Will the spirit finally find peace, or will the truth remain buried in The Cellar? Costumes are encouraged. Mystery awaits. Get Your Tickets Here!

events.title: Fright Night Halloween Party
events.description: This Halloween, we’re bringing a little mystery, a little magic, and plenty of good wine to Christopher Cellars! Join us for our annual Fright Night Halloween Party, featuring an evening of music, costumes, wine, tarot readings, and Halloween festivities inside our historic winery. Wine & Tarot: Let the Cards Guide You We’re adding something a little mystical to this year’s celebration! Step into the world of ancient wisdom and modern energy with a special Wine & Tarot experience featuring psychic advisor Melody. Throughout the evening, guests will have the opportunity to explore the mysterious world of spiritual readings, including: • Tarot Card Readings: Discover what the cards may reveal about love, relationships, career, and life’s possibilities. • Palm Readings: Explore the ancient tradition of palmistry and the stories believed to be written in the lines of your hands. • Crystal Ball Readings: Experience a little Halloween mysticism through the art of crystal gazing. Whether you’re a believer, simply curious, or looking for something different to experience with friends, this is a fun opportunity to embrace the spirit of Halloween. DJ Torrey Tee | 5:00 PM – 8:00 PM DJ Torrey Tee is bringing the soundtrack to our Halloween celebration! Expect a lively mix of crowd favorites, throwbacks, and dance-worthy hits throughout the evening. Halloween Costume Contest Come dressed in your Halloween best! Whether you’re going spooky, glamorous, creative, or completely outrageous, we’ll be hosting a costume contest with a chance to win. Halloween Wine & Candy Pairing Flight Who says Halloween candy is just for kids? We’re putting a grown-up twist on trick-or-treating with a special Halloween wine flight featuring Christopher Cellars wines paired with classic Halloween candies. Explore how sweetness, acidity, tannins, and fruit characteristics interact with some of your favorite seasonal treats. Specialty Halloween Drinks In addition to our small-lot wines available by the glass and bottle, we’ll be serving festive Halloween-inspired specialty drinks throughout the evening. Food Truck On-Site Come hungry! We’ll have West Coast Taco Bar serving delicious food throughout the celebration.

events.title: Friday Night with BlueSoul Acoustics
events.description: Live Music 4:30–7:30 PM | JJ's Fusion Eats We're taking Friday Night Live Music inside the cellar as the November evenings begin to cool down. With the music a little closer, mulled wine warming on the bar, and the historic barn as our backdrop, we're looking forward to a different kind of Friday at Christopher Cellars. BlueSoul Acoustic joins us from 4:30–7:30 PM, bringing a blend of folk, Americana, indie, and acoustic favorites. Led by Montreal-born musician Terry MacNeill, whose performing career spans more than three decades, BlueSoul draws from artists including Neil Young, Dave Matthews Band, Coldplay, and Oasis. Expect familiar songs, expressive vocals, and the kind of acoustic performance that feels right at home in a smaller setting. JJ's Fusion Eats will be serving their creative, globally inspired menu, including gourmet burgers and chicken sandwiches. At the bar, we'll be pouring our seasonal mulled wine , along with our small-lot wines available by the glass, bottle, or tasting flight. This will be an entirely indoor event, with limited seating available on a first-come, first-served basis. Arrive early, find a spot, and enjoy a Friday evening tucked away in the cellar.

events.title: Friday Night with Jon Spivack
events.description: Live Music: 4:30–7:30 PM | Local Food Truck We're bringing Friday Night Live Music indoors with mulled wine warming on the bar, acoustic guitar filling the cellar, and the charm of our historic barn, we're looking forward to a more intimate Friday at Christopher Cellars. Live Music with Jon Spivack Joining us from 4:30–7:30 PM is Sacramento guitarist Jon Spivack, a seasoned musician who has been performing throughout the region for more than 25 years. Jon's music moves effortlessly between jazz, folk, blues, and Latin influences, drawing on a diverse repertoire of familiar melodies and timeless classics. His album Branching Out showcases his versatility, from solo jazz guitar to folk and blues duets and Latin-inspired arrangements. Having performed at venues including the Crocker Art Museum, Shady Lady, and several Northern California wineries, Jon brings a thoughtful, expressive approach to the guitar that's particularly suited to the intimate setting of our cellar. Mulled Wine & Seasonal Sips We'll be serving warm, aromatic mulled wine alongside our collection of small-lot Christopher Cellars wines, available by the glass, bottle, or tasting flight. A local food truck will also be on-site serving dinner throughout the evening. This will be an entirely indoor event, with limited seating available on a first-come, first-served basis. Arrive early to find a spot and spend your Friday evening enjoying live guitar, a glass of wine, and the quieter side of the winery.

events.title: Friday Night with Nitewind
events.description: Live Music: 4:30–7:30 PM | Local Food Truck We're bringing Friday Night Live Music indoors with mulled wine warming on the bar, familiar songs filling the cellar, and the character of our historic barn setting the scene, we're looking forward to a lively but intimate Friday at Christopher Cellars. Live Music with Nitewind Returning to Christopher Cellars from 4:30–7:30 PM is Nitewind , a Sacramento-based, family-run band known for its impressive musical range and rich vocal harmonies. Founded in 2015, NiteWind features Traci, Michael, and Jared Noche, three accomplished musicians whose backgrounds span international performances, professional recording, and decades of live entertainment. Their repertoire moves between classic rock, jazz, country, pop, and timeless favorites from the 1970s through today. From smooth interpretations of songs by Santana and Nat King Cole to familiar hits by Fleetwood Mac, Journey, and contemporary artists, Nitewind brings a little something for every generation. With multiple vocalists, acoustic guitar, and a natural connection with their audience, Nitewind has become a familiar favorite at Christopher Cellars. Their versatility makes every performance a little different, and we're pleased to welcome them back for an evening inside the cellar. Mulled Wine & Seasonal Sips We'll be serving warm, aromatic mulled wine , alongside our collection of small-lot Christopher Cellars wines available by the glass, bottle, or tasting flight. A local food truck will also be on-site serving dinner throughout the evening. This will be an entirely indoor event, with limited seating available on a first-come, first-served basis. Arrive early to find a spot, order a glass of wine, and enjoy an evening of familiar music in the cellar.

events.description: Live Music: 4:30–7:30 PM | Local Food Truck We're bringing Friday Night Live Music with mulled wine warming on the bar, live acoustic music filling the cellar, and the character of our historic barn setting the scene. We're looking forward to a more intimate Friday at Christopher Cellars. Live Music with Shane Q Joining us from 4:30–7:30 PM is Shane Q , Sacramento's own soulful vocalist and Top 10 finalist from Season 17 of NBC's The Voice . Shane gained national recognition in 2019 with his rendition of Chris Stapleton's "Tennessee Whiskey," earning a four-chair turn from the celebrity coaches before joining Team Kelly Clarkson.
